findings.title: Amount claimed differs from total bills
findings.detail: The amount claimed on the claim form does not match the sum of the hospital bill total and the pharmacy invoice.

findings.title: USG Abdomen report missing
findings.detail: An USG Abdomen is billed and mentioned in the discharge summary, but the report is not found in the file.

quotes.quote: USG Abdomen on 13 Sep 2024 showed an inflamed, non-compressible appendix.

findings.title: Investigation report missing
findings.detail: General investigation charges are billed, but the corresponding investigation reports are not found in the file.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill from outside pharmacy does not match discharge prescription
findings.detail: An outside pharmacy bill from WellMed Pharmacy includes medicines, but no external prescription matching this pharmacy invoice is found in the file.
